59ce69e91c9f7101.description:
Are you a detail-oriented individual with a passion for research and a good understanding of national and local geography This freelance opportunity allows you to work at your own pace and from the comfort of your own home.

A Day in the Life of an Online Data Analyst:

• In this role, you will be working on a project aimed at enhancing the content and quality of digital maps that are used by millions of people worldwide

• Completing research and evaluation tasks in a web-based environment such as verifying and comparing data, and determining the relevance and accuracy of information.

Join us today and be part of a dynamic and innovative team that is making a difference in the world!

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

Qualification path

No previous professional experience is required to apply to this role, however, working on this project will require you to pass the basic requirements and go through a standard assessment process. This is a part-time long-term project and your work will be subject to our standard quality assurance checks during the term of this agreement. 

Basic Requirements

• Full Professional Proficiency in Kannada & English language

• Being a resident in India for the last 5 consecutive years and having familiarity with current and historical business, media, sport, news, social media, and cultural affairs in India.

• Ability to follow guidelines and conduct online research using search engines, online maps, and website information

• Flexibility to work across a diverse set of task types, including maps, news, audio tasks, and relevance

• Daily access to a broadband internet connection, computer, and relevant software

Assessment

In order to be hired into the program, youll take an open book qualification exam that will determine your suitability for the position and complete ID verification. Our team will provide you with guidelines and learning materials before your qualification exam. You will be required to complete the exam in a specific timeframe but at your convenience.

Service Rates 

Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Apply here: https://www.telusinternational.ai/cmp/contributor/jobs/available/129093 utm_source=Shine&utm_medium=Ads&utm_campaign=SHTAxl_APAC_Paid+Site_Shine_Ads_129093

 You may also confirm your interest and send your CV directly via email to sourcingteam103@telusinternational.ai with the subject line: Application for [Job Title] Shine, to ensure your application is promptly received and reviewed

5923554c3a142e18.description: Start your career in SaaS product management with Zoho as a Product Manager Intern (SaaS) in Nizamabad. You will sit with a working team, use the same tools and systems they do, and own a defined piece of work from day one. About the role As a Product Manager Intern (SaaS) at Zoho, your core focus will be discovering user problems and writing the specs that get them solved. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve. What you'll do day to day Work on discovering user problems and writing the specs that get them solved alongside the core team Use Agile / Scrum, User Discovery & Interviews, Wireframing, PRD Writing, Roadmap Planning on live, production-facing problems Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive Collaborate across functions engineering, product, design or business as the work demands Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan Skills you'll build You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Agile / Scrum, User Discovery & Interviews, Wireframing, PRD Writing, Roadmap Planning, Competitive Analysis, Product Analytics, Backlog Grooming, Stakeholder Communication, Prioritisation Frameworks (RICE / MoSCoW) the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished rsum, and every one of these skills is taught on the job. Who should apply Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech, BBA/MBA, BCA/MCA, B.Des or any graduate with strong product projects based in or willing to work from Nizamabad. You should be willing to learn Agile / Scrum, User Discovery & Interviews, Wireframing and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory. Internship details This is a 4-month internship in Nizamabad, Telangana, with a stipend of 34,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a PRD that became a shipped feature. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion. By the end of the internship you will have hands-on command of the tools and workflows used in the field, plus the confidence that comes from solving genuine problems rather than textbook ones. Interns who excel are regularly offered a PPO and a path into a full-time position. How to apply Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Zoho's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. Responsibilities: Work on discovering user problems and writing the specs that get them solved alongside the core team; Apply Agile / Scrum, User Discovery & Interviews, Wireframing, PRD Writing to live, production-facing problems; Document your work clearly for reviewers and stakeholders; Participate in reviews and act on the feedback you receive; Collaborate across engineering, product, design or business as required; Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards. Requirements: Pursuing or recently completed B.E./B.Tech, BBA/MBA, BCA/MCA, B.Des or any graduate with strong product projects 2026 freshers & final-year students welcome; Working knowledge of Agile / Scrum, User Discovery & Interviews, Wireframing (or a genuine willingness to learn them); Strong fundamentals in your discipline and clear problem-solving ability; Care with detail and the discipline to document your work; Clear written and verbal communication in English; Based in or willing to work from Nizamabad, Telangana. .
